entries.title: His Humility
entries.body: He washed feet before He wore a crown. What that taught me about my own hospital bed.

entries.title: His Compassion
entries.body: "Moved with compassion" appears again and again. He never treated suffering as an inconvenience.

entries.title: His Forgiveness
entries.body: "Father, forgive them" from a cross. I had to learn to say it from a hospital bed about a much smaller cross.

entries.title: His Servanthood
entries.body: Greatness looked like a towel and a basin. I found mine in the small kindnesses of the sick ward.
